name: Clone yourself
about: You two or three times in one frame. Record the takes separately with the camera NOT moving; you are cut out of each extra take and laid over the first.
about_tl: Dalawa o tatlo ka sa iisang frame. I-record nang hiwalay ang bawat take nang HINDI gumagalaw ang camera.

inputs.label: Your other takes (same camera position)
inputs.tl: Ang iba mong take (parehong puwesto ng camera)
